Initialise a baseline intervention effects object

Source: R/interventions.R
init_baseline_intervention.Rd

Builds a no-intervention baseline effects object from the host parameters in model_p. All three host types start with identical parameters — no intervention applied. Used internally by build_intervention.

When dummy_host = TRUE a fourth host type ("dummy host") is appended with all parameters set to zero. Its availability is subsequently set by build_intervention() when "KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute" is supplied in the efficacy vector.

Usage

init_baseline_intervention(model_p, npoints, dummy_host = FALSE)

Arguments

model_p

Model object from build_model_obj().

npoints

Number of interpolation time points.

dummy_host

Logical. If TRUE, add a fourth dummy-host column (all zeros) to all effects matrices. Default FALSE.

Value

A list with fields id, description, parameterisation, and effects.
